Filtering and selection rules preserve these subgroup cues. Captured inventory contains only 14 original source questions; no affected stored generated instances were demonstrated.

findings.description: Selecting the second-largest numeric option answers all five exact batch records correctly. All five survive delivery filtering. This is a demonstrated batch failure; that overall strategy is not perfect across the full catalog.
